why: FALSE POSITIVE GUARD for the widened permalink veto. A group post's self-link is /groups/<id>/posts/..., and a local buy-and-sell post's is /commerce/listing/... - neither is /posts/ on a profile. Before 1.1.71 the veto knew only the profile shape, so a group post sharing a link matched the ad rule exactly.
